name: io.github.dimitrovakulenko/dwg-mcp-server
title: DWG MCP Server
description: Read-only MCP server for inspecting AutoCAD DWG files

environmentVariables.name: DWG_MCP_ALLOWED_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Semicolon-separated absolute directories allowed for DWG access when the MCP client, AI agent, or test harness does not provide MCP roots. Optional when MCP roots are supported.

environmentVariables.name: DWG_MCP_DOCKER_MOUNTS
environmentVariables.description: Semicolon-separated host folders mounted read-only into the Docker launcher at their original absolute paths. Access is still authorized by MCP client roots or DWG_MCP_ALLOWED_ROOTS. Defaults to DWG_MCP_ALLOWED_ROOTS, then ~/Documents when omitted.
